question:
A box is made by folding the given sheet. In the box so formed, which face will be opposite to the face having [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accc4e6a8dc545313c26b6a0dd4ecf9587f2f5a3ee3413fe369d46cb4e7444de.png] ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0203539a1d1f0eaeb56810454d7638f87bfd21ce560e8e957080ce3c7ccb1dcf.png]
solution:
The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/579d9afde95b446245cf62ad3b7fa9b04881e695c6b7e844e7908921c74d96d1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a809381fa00a24ed73bef9dd92fc2ddf2cf2835d98fdd4d79946aadee0844df1.png] 

 

Hence, ‘ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b65fbe1938b8c8b36fe3e442c4f0310e357c835e0479880da596da853b39d8c.png] ’ is the opposite face of the face [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/accc4e6a8dc545313c26b6a0dd4ecf9587f2f5a3ee3413fe369d46cb4e7444de.png]
